audit: TIC/TA, signed CO2, minimal carbonate outflow, explicit sources and sinks
interpretation: All carbon and alkalinity terms match pinned source or declared minimal luminal chemistry. Apical CO2 cancels across compartments; internal chemistry creates neither conserved quantity. Every net carbon/TA exchange is a named reservoir exchange or named outflow. No arbitrary TA drain exists. Steady rows imply Db+Da=H, Da=-oCO2, pHCO3=-oHCO3 and Db=H+oCO2.
limitations: Minimal lumen chemistry explicitly neglects carbonate, H/OH and tiny buffer; it is not exact full speciation.
With H and oCO2 nonnegative the balance constraints imply Db>=0, Da<=0; those implied signs do not demonstrate concentration gradients.
An open external bath can supply carbon, sodium and other solutes through declared transport; this is not a hidden source.
LP bookkeeping does not establish physiological pH, composition, membrane potentials or energy adequacy.
